title: SystemError when passing an empty byte string in Python 3.x

labels.name: type: bug
labels.description: problem that needs to be addressed

body:
Under Python 3.x with pytest 2.8.1

``` python
import pytest

@pytest.mark.parametrize("message", [b""])
def test_broken(message):
    pass
```

causes a SystemError during the call to `codecs.escape_encode` inside `_escape_bytes`. This was introduced in commit https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest/commit/e1063678f10b48c5872f6e9d829c21be9097748b, but is really a CPython bug as `codecs.escape_encode(b'')` should not cause a SystemError. That said, pytest probably needs to work around the bug for now.
